persistence_checksum_boundary.description: Persistence, serialization, canonicalization or checksum boundary changes.

temporal_lineage_semantics.description: Time availability, freshness, lineage or anti-lookahead semantics change.

state_machine_or_concurrency.description: State-machine, idempotency or concurrency semantics change.

security_trust_boundary.description: Security, permission or trust-boundary semantics change.

risk_execution_permission.description: Risk, execution, order authority or permission-to-trade boundary changes.

dependency_change.description: Runtime/dev dependency set or pinning changes.

ci_evidence_topology_change.description: CI topology, evidence routing or certification workflow changes.

underdeclaration_checks.rule: Any SCHEMA or CONTRACT output requires contract_schema_families >= 1.
Any allowed path under .github/workflows requires ci_evidence_topology_change=true.
Any allowed path under src/crypto_quant_bot requires production_modules >= 1.
